terra.problem: The line calls Baal-peor a mountain. Peor is the mountain; Baal of Peor is the god, and Baal-peor can also refer to the place associated with his worship. The cited verses do not say Israel’s worship or judgment happened on the mountain. Numbers 25:1–3 places Israel at Shittim when the worship began.
The Moses and Hosea moments are later recollections, not events shown happening at Baal-peor. Psalm 106 also recalls the worship without locating it on the mountain.
Words such as “yoked,” “consecrated,” and “detestable” may be above a fifth-grade reading level. Use simpler wording or explain them.
